Overall, this credit card is a suitable option for consumers looking for a low annual fee card to save on Apollo services.

faqs.q: What are the welcome benefits offered on Apollo SBI Card?
faqs.a: The card offers 500 reward points worth Rs. 500 upon payment of the joining fee. The card also comes with complimentary Apollo Gold Tier Membership benefits.

faqs.q: What rewards can I earn on Apollo SBI Card?
faqs.a: You can earn 3 reward points per Rs. 100 spent on Apollo services, 2 reward points per Rs. 100 on dining, movies, and entertainment, and 1 reward point on eligible spends across other categories.

faqs.q: Does Apollo SBI Card offer annual fee waiver?
faqs.a: Yes, the annual fee can be waived on spending Rs. 1 Lakh or more in a card anniversary year.

faqs.q: Is there any fuel benefit on Apollo SBI Card?
faqs.a: Yes, the card offers 1% fuel surcharge waiver across fuel stations in India, subject to a maximum waiver of Rs. 100 per month.

faqs.q: Who should apply for Apollo SBI Card?
faqs.a: This card is suitable for consumers who frequently spend on healthcare, pharmacy, wellness, and Apollo-related services and want rewards on everyday lifestyle categories as well.

faqs.q: Does Apollo SBI Card offer discounts on Apollo services?
faqs.a: Yes, cardholders can avail up to 10% instant discount on select Apollo services as per applicable offers.
